instruction:
ALWAYS name the capability IDs explicitly in canonicalPrompt when the user prompt matches.
For ambiguous AI-saas prompts, prefer fullstack-ts or nextjs-ts family.
Route rules (ordered):
- If prompt mentions any of [that, build, answers, step, tool, analyzes] include "capability:ai-chat-ui" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [build, that, tool, customer, sentiment, with] include "capability:layout-dashboard" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [build, tool, that, customer, sentiment, trends] include "capability:chart-widget" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [step, build, homework, helper, students, that] include "capability:layout-chat" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [build, step, homework, helper, students, that] include "capability:tailwind" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [want, peer-to-peer, tool, lending, platform, neighbors] include "capability:marketplace" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [build, dashboard, voting, customer, feedback, tool] include "capability:shadcn" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [build, telehealth, where, doctors, video, consultations] include "capability:layout-auth" in canonicalPrompt.
- If prompt mentions any of [that, shows, build, pulls, from, listings] include "capability:agent-intel" in canonicalPrompt.
ALWAYS include capability:tailwind for any UI that renders pages.
ALWAYS include capability:layout-dashboard when prompt describes analytics, tracking, monitoring, or multiple views.
ALWAYS include capability:layout-chat when prompt describes messaging, conversation, or companion UX.
ALWAYS include capability:ai-chat-ui when the product is AI-driven or talks to the user.
signature: "Turn a user product prompt into a structured product brief that drives a deterministic scaffold pipeline downstream. The canonicalPrompt must be a keyword-rich expansion that names concrete technologies drawn from knownFamilies (e.g. nextjs-ts, fullstack-ts, agent-service-ts, go-api, python-api, forge-contracts, solana-program) and concrete UI/infra capabilities drawn from knownCapabilities (e.g. capability:ai-chat-ui, capability:layout-dashboard, capability:saas-billing). It MUST be longer and more specific than the user prompt. Preserve the user intent exactly. Each list field should have 3-8 items." userPrompt:string, knownFamilies:string[], knownCapabilities:string[] -> canonicalPrompt:string, vision:string, taskChecklist:string[], milestones:string[], testingPlan:string[], e2ePlan:string[], securityConcerns:string[], openQuestions:string[], confidence:number
